editorial.blurb: A buzzy new pizzeria and raw bar from the team behind beloved Daisies, serving inventive thin-crust pizzas, pristine oysters, and seriously clever cocktails at refreshing prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation, especially for evenings—the place fills up fast. Order the oysters with all the fixings so you can try different preparations, and don't skip the $10 cocktails like Lady of the Lake or Catholic Guilt, which punch well above their price point.
